# Ivy

> Ivy is the all-in-one business platform for solopreneurs, with an AI assistant that does your busywork. One plan covers booking, invoicing, a client CRM, two-way messaging, e-signature, a website builder, email campaigns and the Ivy assistant. $8.99 per week after a 14-day free trial, or $374.99 per year. Payments go straight to the owner's own Stripe account at Stripe's standard rate. The client portal is free for clients.

Ivy is made for solo service businesses: massage therapists, coaches, hair stylists, photographers, personal trainers, contractors, tutors, and every other business of one. The owner is the only one who pays. Clients never pay to use the portal.

## What Ivy does

- Ivy AI assistant: reads the owner's real numbers and answers in plain English with specific actions. It can draft invoices and quotes, book sessions, create tasks, log expenses and build automations from a plain-English description. Anything that reaches a client waits for the owner's approval. 600 assistant messages a month are included.
- Booking and scheduling: a public booking page at the owner's own link, services, packages and class capacity, per-weekday availability, deposits, intake forms and signatures collected in the booking flow, Google Calendar sync, and automatic reminders by email and SMS before each appointment, at the times the owner chooses.
- Money: branded invoices and recurring billing, card on file with late-cancel and no-show policies, memberships, packages and gift cards, in-person sales by QR code, overdue reminders on autopilot, and a finance dashboard with a tax export compatible with QuickBooks and Xero. Payments go straight to the owner's Stripe account; Ivy never touches the money.
- Clients: unlimited clients and a pipeline, CSV import, two-way client messaging with photos and voice memos, automatic review requests and referral rewards, and a free client portal for bookings, invoices, signed forms and messages.
- Presence: website builder with custom domain and built-in SEO, documents and legally binding e-signature, email campaigns to all clients or tagged segments, and an iPhone app with Face ID and push notifications on the same account as the web.

## Pricing

- $8.99 per week, one plan, everything included, no per-seat fees.
- $374.99 per year on annual billing, about 20% less than paying weekly.
- 14-day free trial with the whole product unlocked, $0 today, cancel anytime.
- Clients pay nothing. The client portal is free for them, always.

## Security and data

- Every workspace is isolated; the AI assistant can only see that workspace's data.
- Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Payment data never touches Ivy's servers; client cards go straight to Stripe.
- Owners can export everything (clients, bookings, invoices, documents, messages) as CSV and JSON at any time from their account page.
- Production infrastructure is hosted in the United States.

## Free tools

Free tools for solo service businesses. They run in the browser, need no signup, and send nothing anywhere. Index: https://www.joinivy.ai/tools

- [Cancellation policy generator](https://www.joinivy.ai/tools/cancellation-policy-generator): writes a plain-language cancellation and no-show policy from a notice window, fees, deposit and tone; copy or download it.
- [Booking deposit calculator](https://www.joinivy.ai/tools/deposit-calculator): from the owner's own price, weekly bookings and no-show estimate, shows what missed bookings cost and what a deposit would keep, with the math.
- [Client intake form templates](https://www.joinivy.ai/tools/intake-form-templates): ready-to-copy intake questions for massage therapists, hair stylists, personal trainers, coaches, photographers, tutors, estheticians and cleaners.
- [No-show cost calculator](https://www.joinivy.ai/blog/no-show-cost-calculator)
